A desire to be governed by our elected politicians rather than faceless Eurocrats has been cited as one of the main reasons for leaving the EU. We have the chief Brexiteers, who disappeared when the going got tough, the Prime Minister, who has little support for her one possible solution and Jeremy Corbyn – a man who does not seem to be able to mount a credible opposition. Throughout the negotiations, the EU has run rings round our representatives. Who would we prefer to be governed by? GERRYRADFORD CAMBRIDGE
